title: 可解释性理解标注者安全策略
summary: 提出标注者策略模型（APMs），从标注行为中学习标注者内部安全策略，无需额外标注即可揭示标注分歧原因（操作失误、政策模糊、价值多元），准确率>80%，支持更透明、包容的安全政策设计。
summary_en: Introduces Annotator Policy Models (APMs) that learn annotators' internal safety policies from labeling behavior alone, revealing sources of annotation disagreement (operational failures, policy ambiguity, value pluralism) with >80% accuracy, enabling more transparent and inclusive safety policy design.
